$comment: Seed evaluation set (plan §J Phase 2/3). Questions are phrased the way a listener would ask, mostly without naming the guest. `expect` lists RSS guids (stable across re-ingests) of episodes that should appear in the top 10 retrieved passages. Questions whose episodes are not indexed are skipped, not failed. `unanswerable` questions must come back mode=insufficient with no citations.
